gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies the static factory methods of {@link JsonIgnoreProperties.Value} and how the "allow getters" / "allow setters" flags affect which properties are report
ADDED i2: The canonical shared "no settings" instance that factory methods return when given empty input.
ADDED i3: Builds an ordered set from the given names, matching the type returned by the Value getters.
ADDED i4: Factory calls that carry no actual settings should all reuse the shared EMPTY instance.
ADDED i5: A value built from two ignored property names exposes exactly those names.
ADDED i6: "allow getters": getters stay active, so the names are ignored only for deserialization.
ADDED i7: "allow setters": setters stay active, so the names are ignored only for serialization.
